Correct. Sorry to bug the tech guys but it was the email on my order slip and I was hoping it might actually reach someone.

Sent from my iPhone
Note to the team: I'll pull up the order before replying.

Tim,

You are right to be frustrated, and I am sorry. Here is the honest picture of Shop····.

You ordered the Hammer Miner DC04 on October 12 and it was stamped to ship by October 19. It never reached our warehouse, so it was never picked or labelled. That was our mistake, not a stock issue, and nobody closed the loop with you afterwards. The D.04 is also not back for sale and carries no ship date, so I am not going to tell you to keep waiting on it.

What I can do today, myself, is move your order onto a unit that is physically on the shelf:

Hammer Miner Thor P2, 10 TH/s, $379. In stock, ships within 2 business days. That is $80 more than the DC04, invoiced to you, and it goes out once paid.

Hammer Miner BC04, 6 TH/s, $249. In stock, ships within 2 business days. That is $50 back to your original payment when I make the change.

Your Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA stays on the order either way, at no cost.

Just reply with the one you want and I will make the change the same day and send you the details. If neither works for you, tell me that too and I will take it from there.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
